sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 12:82

items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 12:82:1
items.html: And in the correction, they were impregnated with a first Ibur, and the vessels of the VAK were clarified little by little: As said in the adjacent item, that all the correction of ZA, from the discernment of his essence and self, is only for the anterior vessels, which are GE alone, which are the six vessels of HGT NHY, whose time of clarification is called first Ibur, and they are clarified through two couplings: the first coupling for the vessel of Galgalta, which is called HGT, and the second coupling for the vessel of Einayim, which is called NHY. Also within the first coupling there are particular couplings until he completes the NRNHY of Nefesh, and likewise within the second coupling there are particular couplings until he completes the NRNHY of Ruach, which continue over the course of the days of the nursing. And this is what he said, that the vessels of the VAK were clarified little by little.

items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 12:82:2
items.html: And what was not clarified of the vessels and remained mixed, good and evil, remained in the belly of Ima: This refers to the vessels of Hod, Yesod, and Malchut, which were not clarified during the time of the Ibur, but rather in the course of the time of the nursing, as above.
